title: Actual and strict-tower completed exchange agree under canonical transport
statement: For an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], a chosen Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], and an intrinsically complete ambient input K, the actual completed ambient-mate exchange [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] is carried to the ordered strict-tower exchange [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map] by isomorphisms on its source and target. Explicitly there exist s: Lg_actual Rf_actual K ≅ Lg_datum Rf_datum K and t: Rf_prime_actual Lg_prime_actual K ≅ Rf_prime_datum Lg_prime_datum K satisfying Ex_actual(K) ≫ t.hom = s.hom ≫ Ex_datum(K). No properness, noetherian-scheme, dimension, constructibility or boundedness assumption is needed.

source.place: Tags 0D6D and 099N, ordinary derived composition on resolving models and completed pullback via quotient towers; refinement of thm-weil-pbc-qbar finite-stage proof, identifying the two existing completed-exchange presentations.

proof.text: The finite coefficient projections identify the actual coefficient map with the datum coefficient isomorphism. Hence actual and datum module pushforward agree, while their pullbacks have the specified counit-normalized transport. Their tensor-unit normalized adjunctions and section-normalized composition comparisons identify the two ordinary exchange mates.

For an intrinsically complete input, compose the inverse actual strict-tower/reflection comparison with the datum strict-tower comparison. Apply this at Rf K for the source (direct image preserves completeness), and apply Rf prime to it at K for the target.

Precompose both candidate completed arrows with the actual completion unit. Naturality of completion and the unit normalization of the direct-image/completion isomorphism reduce actual completed exchange to its ordinary mate. The two strict-tower transport unit equations and the ordered completedExchange_unit equation reduce the other side to the same ordinary mate. The universal completion reflection cancels the unit.

lean.statement:
theorem pbcActualCompletedExchange_transport
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g)
    (K : PbcCompletedDerived X d) (hK : PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete X d K) :
    ∃ (source : (pbcActualCompletedPull g d).obj ((pbcActualDerivedPush f d).obj K) ≅
        (d.completedPull g).obj ((d.push f).obj K))
      (target : (pbcActualDerivedPush f' d).obj ((pbcActualCompletedPull g' d).obj K) ≅
        (d.push f').obj ((d.completedPull g').obj K)),
      (pbcActualCompletedExchange d sq).app K ≫ target.hom =
        source.hom ≫ d.completedExchange sq K
